question: Will China make an aggressive move against Taiwan before Trump's second term ends (January 20, 2029)
quote: Yeah, I agree with that. Fifteen percent. It could happen, but I think on balance it won't. I'm not quite where Michael is. I think I say one percent, which is very close to saying absolutely won't happen. But yeah, 15, 20 percent.
turn_text: Charlie. Yeah, I agree with that. Fifteen percent. It could happen, but I think on balance it won't. I'm not quite where Michael is. I think I say one percent, which is very close to saying absolutely won't happen. But yeah, 15, 20 percent.
host_quote: So I ask the question to you first. MBD percentage odds that there'll be some aggressive Chinese move against Taiwan before Donald Trump's second term is out.
resolution_criteria: Between the air date and noon ET on January 20, 2029, the People's Republic of China takes an aggressive military or coercive action against Taiwan beyond routine exercises and incursions: a blockade or quarantine, seizure of Taiwan-held territory such as an outlying island, a kinetic strike, or an invasion. Decided by the Associated Press or Reuters reporting that it has happened. Resolves YES as soon as the event is recorded as having happened on or before 2029-01-20; otherwise NO on 2029-01-20.
